title: Fullstack-Developer (100% Remote)
description:
We're looking for Junior and Senior Developers to join our fully remote team. If you like complexity and want your work to actually matter, you'll fit right in.

**About Us**


Hausverwalter.ai is an all\-in\-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI\-Agents. Our mission is to automate *everything* a property manager does.

**What you'll do**


You'll build with Claude and Cursor. What exactly you work on depends on where you land — our work splits roughly like this:

* **Product (Full\-Stack).** Work on the software property managers use all day. Help us improve what's there and push our roadmap forward by owning new features and refining them until they're as easy to use as the Uber app.
* **Integrations (Backend)**. Handle every way data gets into our platform. Email, phone calls (Twilio \& Vonage), WhatsApp. The other half is moving customers off whatever they used before: Importing years of email, hundreds of thousands of documents, and every record on their buildings, apartments, contracts and contacts, plus syncing with systems a customer still runs alongside us.
* **Agents (Backend).** Improve the agent platform behind hausverwalter.ai with 200\+ tools and a built\-in knowledge base. Customers build and train their own agents in a sandbox or use agents we've already built for them. Both text and voice.

title: Senior Backend-Developer – Agents (100% Remote)
description:

Hausverwalter.ai is an all\-in\-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI\-Agents. Our mission is to automate *everything* a property manager does.

**About the role**


Our platform has been an agentic platform since day one. Before we even planned the UI, we planned the way agents would interact with the software. Remember – our goal is to automate the entire industry and we mean it.


As of now, almost everything the user can do in the UI, we have an agent tool for it and the Co\-Pilot (daily assistant of the user) can do everything for them, even toggling dark mode on and off.


But the Co\-Pilot is just the beginning. The real challenge is the autonomous agents. More on that below.

* **Inbox\-Agents**: Autonomous Agents triggered whenever something new happens inside a ticket. The customer can train them on their own OR rather use one of the templates you will build for them. title: Software-Architect / System-Designer (100% Remote)
description:
We're seeking an experienced Software architect / Full\-Stack Developer who thinks like a Systems Designer – someone who reaches for schema diagrams and load assumptions before reaching for code. You'll join our fully remote team. If you like complexity, enjoy reasoning about data, scale and reliability, want to implement AI\-solutions and enjoy working with Claude/Cursor/Codex, this could be the right role for you.

**What you'll do**

* Own the system design – you decide how data is modeled, where state lives, how components talk to each other, and how the whole system behaves under load
* Make the hard, hard\-to\-reverse design decisions early – and reason explicitly about the trade\-offs behind them
* Design and own our data layer from the ground up for new features – tables and relationships, indexing strategy, and query/load optimization that holds up as data and traffic grow
* Design queues, background jobs and long\-running workflows that stay correct and reliable under heavy load and partial failure
* Contribute to architecture decisions, the direction of our stack, and the overall product vision
* Operate in an AI\-first development setup powered by Claude/Cursor

title: Kotlin/Java Developer - Spring Boot, datové integrace, automotive
description:
**Do** našeho **Software Engineering týmu hledáme** už zkušenějšího **Kotlin/Java developera,** který zvládne pracovat samostatně, nemá problém komunikovat se zákazníkem a při vývoji aktivně využívá AI nástroje.


Konkrétně od našeho kolegy **převezmeš projekt pro zákazníka z automotive, kde vyvíjíme aplikaci pro analýzu dat o kvalitě. Výzvou tu není ani tak architektura a byznys logika, ale integrace více datových zdrojů, komplexní databázové dotazy a orientace v automotive doméně.**


Neočekáváme, že budeš expertem úplně na všechno, ale v Kotlinu/Javě a Spring Bootu by ses měl cítit jako doma.


### **Čemu se budeš věnovat:**


* Vývoji back\-endu v Kotlinu/Javě a Spring Bootu, včetně integrace více datových zdrojů
* Tvorbě a ladění komplexních databázových dotazů
* Návrhu a konzumaci API podle standardů REST a OpenAPI
* K tvé práci bude patřit i kritické čtení specifikací, doplňování chybějících detailů s analytiky a code review
* Budeš v kontaktu se zákazníkem (s techniky i manažery)
* Spolupracovat budeš s databázovými specialisty, frontend vývojáři, analytiky a projektovým managementem

### **Budeme si rozumět, pokud:**


* Máš praktické zkušenosti s vývojem back\-endu v Kotlinu/Javě a znáš výborně Spring Boot
* Dobře znáš JPA, Hibernate a MyBatis
* Používáš běžně AI nástroje (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex apod.) při vývoji, umíš z nich vytěžit maximum a znáš jejich limity
* Máš zkušenosti s REST API a OpenAPI, Maven/Gradle, Gitem, Dockerem a psaním unit a integračních test
